# gtk4's canvasText override under --simulate, with no C toolchain: each frame
# hands cairo the font family and the text as C strings, and nothing frees
# either (#110), so each leaks once per settle. ReleaseTemps makes this pass.

env PATH=

! sngl test --simulate gtk4 app.sngl
stdout -count=2 '^    leak: the C.CString allocated at platform/gtk4/gtk4.sngl:[0-9]+:[0-9]+ was never released, [0-9]+ times$'

sngl test app.sngl
stdout '^PASS$'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"
import "sngl:test"

component label ui.node {
    var n = 0

    draw.canvas(width=200px, height=40px) {
        draw.canvasText(x=4.0, y=20.0, content="count: {n}", style=draw.Style{fontFamily="serif"})
    }
}

func testDraws(t test.Test, c label) {
    c.n = 1
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    label
}
